homepage_intro:
Beyond the Algorithm.

No Spotify. No Meta. No Google. No Amazon.

Route666.live is non-commercial website  built for the community. No adverts. Just streaming original music from New Mexico.

If you’ve created something original, we’d love to hear it. Whether it’s music, poetry, spoken word, comedy, storytelling, or any other original recording from New Mexico—submit it right here.

The website runs off an old laptop in my house.

Listen local. Share your work. Discover all the great tracks being recorded and released here. 

Welcome to route666.live.
homepage_sidebar_headline: How to get your music up here
homepage_sidebar_text:
All you got to do:
1. Click on "Submit Profile"
2. Have an album cover/photo to upload.
3. Upload a bio of your band/artist
4. Upload up to 3 tracks in mp3 format
5. Provide links to your music wherever it may be online or for sale.
6. Click submit
